[list]
[*] A long loading time when opening the main menu 
[*] [Controller] Getting stuck in openables (doors, closets, lockers) 
[*] [Controller] Loading screen B Button (going to the main menu) 
[*] [Controller] Ending sequence (going from the ending screen after the prologue to the main menu) 
[/list]
[b]Fixed the following issues in The Time Has Come (Alley):[/b]
[list]
[*] Generator has a blurred screen
[*] Bres disappears after falling from ladder 
[*] General collision issues
[/list]
[b]Changed the following in Subconscious (Dream 2):[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the decal glow of the bird on the first stone in the sequence
[*] Fixed the Run Over Tormentors quest
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Collect Clothes quest in Trailer Park 1 (Beauty and the Beast)
[*] Fixed the issue with the dealer continuing to hit Gitta during the ending sequence in Huff Huff and Puff (Warehouse 4)
[*] Fixed the issue with a double of Gitta appearing when pushing a crate in Hear Me (Warehouse 5)
[*] Fixed the issues with the trip wire trap and quests appearing during cutscenes in Father (Trailer Park 2)
[*] Changed suicide letter format from female to male in Father (Trailer Park 2)
[*] Fixed the Achievement system
[*] Fixed the issue with the Drug Vial counter filling in whenever talking to the dealer in Huff Huff and Puff (Bar)
[*] The number of story-items on the ending screen was changed from 29 to 30 and at the end of Act III from 4 to 5
[*] [Controller] Changed dragables and large movables to RT/R1 on controllers instead of X/Square
[*] [Controller] The controller's layout text was fixed to the correct layout in the pause menu
[*] [Controller] Fixed slow walking animations
[*] Fixed the issue with an infinite loop of loading when clicking back during a loading screen
[*] Fixed the issue with the pause menu staying on screen when spamming ESC and pause 
[*] Fixed the issue in which the player was able to freeze a song’s timer while playing regularly
[/list]

notes.title: Nordic Game Show Footage!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/7cd2fb4a453e15f5c51a1369f3d2369d55118429.jpg[/img]

[h1]Caw, flock![/h1]

As promised, we are excited to share the footage (and early gameplay) from our show at the Nordic Game conference in Malmo, Sweden!

notes.title: Making Small History!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/abe41c422dc88e1adf8063f4ce919ca5aec8c4ec.jpg[/img]

[h1]Caw, flock![/h1]

As some of you might know.. not long ago we had the chance to do something pretty amazing. Truth be told, the title of this post (as far as we know) is actually not misleading.. we made small history.

So what happened? Well.. about half a year ago, Jacob Riis, head of the Nordic Game Conference (the biggest game development conference in Europe) came up with this crazy idea for our project - making a live show of our music while the game is being played live as well and.. is being synced to the live music on stage. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/d0018d2b7aa1109306af835fad36286de1372ba1.jpg[/img]
[i]Davidavi "Vidi" Dolev... You'll get to know him as "Bres"![/i]

Not only this idea sounds crazy.. quickly we found out we have a problem.. when looking for people to consult with about how to do such a thing we couldn't find any for one simple reason.. this seems to never have been done before!

And crazy (and maybe also stupid.. looking back) as this sounds - instead of saying "ok... it's probably not doable.." and giving up on this idea.. we decided to go for it. Lucky for us, both Nordic Game and All-In Games, our publisher were both crazy to actually support this crazy idea and go with it. 

Now.. it's hard to explain how many technical problems this things brings with it but.. syncing interactive things to music is always hard.. truth be told, even syncing video to live shows is not the simplest thing - it's doable, but comes with many problems. A game? Being played live? Synced to live music? And also streamed live by a well known streamer? Well... that's a whole new word of pain we were facing. Where do you even begin?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/031d7c6220a4671f8857accb298c3b1bc8a31fb7.jpg[/img]
[i]Arnold (CEO/Composer) and Kobra who was performing Gitta[/i]

We begun big. Not only we decided that we are going to do it.. we also decided we are going to do it with the actual artists from the game. So.. we brought to Sweden:

[list]
[*]Ron 'Bumblefoot' Thal (ex-Guns N' Roses, Sons of Apollo, Asia) - Guitars
[*]Ruud Jolie (Within Temptation) - Guitars
[*]Rob van der Loo (Epica) - Bass
[*]Kobra Paige (Kobra and the Lotus) - Vocals as Gitta
[*]Davidavi 'Vidi' Dolev (Gunned Down Horses, Subterranean Masquerade)
[*]Yuval Tamir (Gunned Down Horses) - Drums
[*]Eden Rabin (ex-Orphaned Land) - Keyboards
[*]Arnold Nesis (Capricia Productions) - Composer
[*]Ben Shmuelof (Capricia Productions) - Guitars
[*]Sam 'Chaotic' - Playing the game
[*]Dor Ferdman & Octavian Cristea - On-site programmers.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/4b55f9ae032fd8c7a84eac17cf6f9bad55fe6cd1.jpg[/img]
[i]Moments before the show[/i]

Now we were left just with the technical problems and the fear of doing this. Truth be told.. this really is an insane thing to do. We are not an AAA company with endless budget - we are a small indie team and we were going to perform this thing in front of over 1,000 game industry leaders... because.. you know... it's a game development conference... 

Speaking even more honestly - making this thing live is suicide. Live demos is NEVER a good idea, specially in this scenario. At some point we realized we are in over our heads. We would honestly be very impressed if a big company would manage to pull something like this off. We didn't realize just how hard it's going to be going into this. Even after figuring out how to sync a game to live music (bear in mind.. it's a story driven music based game.. not "just" a rhythm game) - we kept running into one from after the other. Builds freezing, music going out of sync - click tracks problems... flight problems.. budget problems.. pretty much any problem you can (or can't) think of.. we had it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/09528b75dafc5cc4127d6ca5f20fc0beb0974818.jpg[/img]
[i]Ben Shmuelof, our producer[/i]

To make matters even worse.. our build kept crashing. Even in Sweden, during rehearsals - it was crashing. Now.. game builds crashing is not new to anyone - it's ok. BUT... in this case it's also a live show. So... if the build crashes - show over. Music stops. Everything restarts. The sky falls down. Sauron attacks. 

We were actually so sure the build is going to crash during the show that we made a bet on stage - if the build crashes, Ben (our producer) has to go on stage and drink a really disgusting shot. If it doesn't.. Arnold (the CEO/Composer) will drink 5 of them in a row at the end of the show. 




[h1]So... how did it go!?  [/h1]

Well... a picture is worth a thousand words, right?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/cdf594e6dd141d3dbc9e56e5bfa85d886a45a921.jpg[/img]

Yes. That's Arnold drinking 5 shots. We made it. And... it was amazing. Best bet he ever lost. 

Looking back, we honestly can't believe we did this. Even now that some time has passed. Apart from the fact that this was a very special thing to do which has never been done before - an approach which is a huge part of this whole project - we proved  to ourselves as a team that dreams do come true. NOTHING is impossible. It's cheesy.. but it's also true. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/3edc737bfebe70c553913e2b4df7d9bbe63d3869.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/7cd2fb4a453e15f5c51a1369f3d2369d55118429.jpg[/img]


Over the next days/weeks we will share more and show more from this experience and it will be more game related - we'll show the actual show and the shots from the game as well as some "behind the scenes" shootings but we wanted to share this experience with you and thank you. Every game here on Steam, no matter how good or bad is at the end of the day a community of people and we couldn't have done that without the help of our community. 

Thank you for being here, dear flock - [b]you (literally) ROCK![/b]

notes.title: Name Change to "Of Bird and Cage" (Yes, this IS the former "The Birdcage")
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/553930c6081d29664e235f6acc977831528e2ad3.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][u]Hello, dear flock![/u][/b][/h1]

So.. a lot of people asked us about the name change and if this is "The Birdcage" (previous name) or a new game. So.. first of all, we want to clarify:
[b]Yes, this is "The Birdcage" and yes, we changed the name[/b]

[b]So... we are happy to present the new logo and the new name! :)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/553930c6081d29664e235f6acc977831528e2ad3.jpg[/img]

[h1]There were a few reasons for the name change and we'll be happy to explain them and how the new name was chosen. [/h1]

Firstly - we'll be honest and admit that while "The Birdcage" is a name we loved, it had a big problem with it because of the movie... we were aware of the movie when we first came up with it, but more people got confused by it than we were expecting. People kept asking about the connection between our game and the movie and as you all probably know.. there is really no connection what-so-ever. To add to the confusion, a few months ago a mobile game with the same name was released and while we (think) we were working on our game for longer and you can't really trademark a "Birdcage" because it's just a word, we wanted to avoid confusion. 

Second reason which is connected to the first is... well.. SEO. When people were searching for the game they heard about somewhere, they found themselves with a lot of info about the movie or the other game and that's obviously not an ideal situation. We would much rather you guys actually finding the game you are looking for for obvious reasons and we believe it's better for everyone. 

We wanted to do this for a while now, but were waiting for the right moment and we felt that right before opening the Steam page would probably be it.


[h1]Now.. for the new name and how it came to be:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947934/cc6b5b352dbdc8bde449f7cbde2ac1eabf292e29.jpg[/img]
[i]Fanart by Yarden Weissbrot[/i]

So, we think it's pretty clear we do like the mental image of a birdcage and it makes perfect sense with our story and the game. So, we did want to keep that image and not to go too far away from the original name so people would still recognize it. 

The SEO came as a big consideration again - being more experiences with game development now than when we begun, we knew we wanted something that will stand out when searching for it and it seems that "Of Bird and Cage" is something that does that. 

But it wasn't all technical of course. Most of the considerations were "artistic". It's been more than 3 years that we've been working on the game and while the difference between "The Birdcage" and "Of Bird and Cage" might not seem huge - it just better works for the story as it was shaped during that time. It's not a story about a birdcage (although Gitta IS in a mental birdcage of a sort).. it's a tale of a bird and a cage, at least this feels more accurate to us. 

There was actually another huge reason for why we feel this name is perfect, but we can't share it without spoilers - you will have to guess it for now. We did hint already though that Metallica fans would have a pretty big clue there ;). 


We hope you guys like it and would love to hear you thoughts on the matter (and all matters). 

Thanks, drear flock!
[i]"Of Bird and Cage" Team[/i]
